budget_items.what_was_recorded: Covid overtime is reimbursable through CARES Act and FEMA; FY20 overtime submitted with 25% received so far, about $7,000 total.
budget_items.quote: so far not a huge amount of money for fy20--approximately $7,000.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Increased PPE spending has been recovered 100%, though reimbursements are not yet received, possibly a short-term cash flow effect.
budget_items.quote: the increase ppe that the town has made has been recovered 100%.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: FY20 revenues exceeded estimate by .6%, a total of $267,291.
budget_items.quote: the revenues of fy20 exceeded estimate of .6% or a total of $267,291.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Expenditures were 2.8% under budget, a total of $1,207, 219 in appropriation close-outs.
budget_items.quote: expenditures were 2.8% less than budgeted for a total of $1,207, 219

budget_items.topic: Undesignated fund balance and free cash
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Undesignated fund balance is $644,000 higher than at the close of FY19; a significant free cash certification is expected.
budget_items.quote: $644,000 higher than at the close of fy19.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Last year's free cash certification was $1,107, 694; this year's may translate almost dollar for dollar.
budget_items.quote: last year's certification of free cash was $1,107, 694

budget_items.what_was_recorded: $7,000 was encumbered from the Parks budget for fence work on the Wallace/Wallis Park basketball court project, covering the overage above the capital appropriation.
budget_items.quote: $7,000 incumbered for the fence work from the parks budget.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: School district would arrange a rare upper-level course through Educere at a cost of $200 per student per course.
budget_items.quote: be taught through educere at a cost of $200 per student per course.
